title: Projects get a clearer map
summary:
Projects got easier to browse, while streaming response setup and the README logo got small repairs.

The website’s project directory was reorganized into seven categories, from Vibe Coding to Learn, with Vibe Coding replacing Featured as the opening view. The README and new PROJECTS.md also gained categorized project tables with clearer links to demos, websites, creators and GitHub repositories.

The text API now awaits the ad eligibility check before setting up OpenAI-compatible response streams, including on error paths. Async code remains very particular about the order in which things happen.

A broken README logo was replaced with a working image and set to use the available width.

daily.title: Find projects by category
daily.text: Browse community projects across seven categories, including Vibe Coding, Creative, Games and Learn. The Projects page now opens on Vibe Coding.
